[SWS_DM_00843] Reset Service Instance fields on end of Diagnostic Conversa-
tion
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04166
⌈
If the life-cycle of a
Diagnostic Conversation
ends, the
Diagnostic Server
instance
shall set the ActivityStatus to inactive
kInactive
.
⌋
Besides the described informative character of the
ara::diag::Conversation
class Interface, it also provides methods for interaction with the state of a
Diagnostic
Conversation
.
